title: nir-eye-cam
description: Small near-infrared cameras for mouse pupil and eye imaging. Firmware for a Himax HM01B0 camera on an RP2040 board and for an ST VD55G1 global-shutter sensor on an ESP32-P4, both streaming 8-bit frames over USB, and a Python recorder that puts several free-running cameras on one timeline by timestamping a shared sync line.
